Pulse Atlas
Fictional product brief for Source to Motion demonstration. These numbers are synthetic test data, not a real company claim.
Product
Pulse Atlas is an incident analytics dashboard that turns incoming events into an actionable response queue.
Last 30 days
2,480 events processed in the last 30 days.
97.4% of incoming events were auto-tagged in the last 30 days.
Median response time was 12 minutes in the last 30 days.
Workflow
Signals become triaged incidents, then owners receive a response card.
